testcase.name: bir51_tc_family_office
testcase.description: BIR51 TC — Family-Owned SPE / Single Family Office

variation.name: bir51_tc_family_office
variation.description: A valid BIR51 tax computation for a family-owned special purpose entity (SPE) in which an eligible family-owned investment holding vehicle has beneficial interest, and where the entity is also an eligible single family office. FamilyOwnedSPE = true and the corresponding profits element is non-zero. EligibleSingleFamilyOfficeOfAFamily = true.
